primitives.name: Minimal Information Principle
primitives.verbatim_quote: - We collect only what is needed to run the service.
primitives.assumptions: Information entropy is minimized subject to service functionality constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When data exceeds operational necessity, risk of violation increases.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Bayesian belief update under constrained information prior.
layer2.telemetry: Entropy of collected data vs. required service features.

primitives.name: Consent-Based Data Lifecycle
primitives.verbatim_quote: We do NOT use your data to train AI models without explicit opt-in consent.
primitives.assumptions: User consent is modeled as a binary predicate over data usage policies.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when implicit or unauthorized training occurs.

layer2.mapping: Derived from GSE's policy engine, enforcing opt-in semantics in agent memory.
layer2.telemetry: Compliance rate of model training against consent flags.

primitives.name: Right to Data Portability
primitives.verbatim_quote: - You can export, correct, or delete your data at any time.
primitives.assumptions: Data portability implies bijective mapping between user and system representations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When export formats are non-standard or inaccessible, user sovereignty fails.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI’s ability to reconstruct user state from portable exports.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of data import/export operations across formats.
